detail.headline: Fell after a share offering priced under yesterday's close
detail.why: Acme sold new shares before the open at a discount to Friday's close, about 4% more shares in all. The market read it as more dilution before revenue arrives, and short sellers piled in on the open.
detail.overdone_case: The cash pays for launches that were already planned, so nothing in the business changed today.
detail.real_case: It is the second raise this year; if launches slip, more offerings could follow.
detail.watch: The next launch window on Nov 24.
detail.plan_note: This doesn't change your plan for Acme.
